page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (small italic labels such as ASIATICA, AFRICA, EUROPA, and a note "Liv. 4") and some faint marginal annotations at the left edge; running head at top with page number 134 and "Darius Nothus" with "Lib. II." at the right; a centred heading "CONTEMPORANEA."

main_text.p: filium mifit, qui non tantum auxilio & pecuniis Lyfandro tempestivè Lyfandro Spartano fubminiftra- vit, fed etiam à patre revocatus, univerfam claffem ei reliquit.
main_text.head: CONTEMPORANEA.
main_text.p: ASIATICAApud JVDÆOS quid geftum fit, hilloria sacra aperiet.
PONTO præfuit Khodobates, & Lacedæmonius Platone credimus.
AFRICANAÆGYPTIORVM res in Perfia gestas ... gimus.
EUROPÆAIn GERMANIA Marcomirus Gallus ... lacessitus, Rhætum transgressus ... Mosam imperium profligat, & mortuus ... tenorem, Priamum & Nicanorem filius reliquit.

In ITALIA multa ROMANI ... gellere. Liv. 4. Veientes M. Aemilius Mamercinus Dictator, postrem male a tribus ... cibus geftam, nihil obstante ... facibus armata, cum Fidenatibus vici, ... tibus 7. XX annorum inducie concilie ... Cum Aequis & Volscis dubio intercluso ... fœlix interdum certavere, Semproneus ... perité prælium infitum, ideo in jus ... Temporius, ut æqua clade ex prælio ... retur, effecit. Fabius ... conjecit. Sempronius ...

page.notes: Marginal and running text in the right half is faint and heavily damaged; several words are illegible. Dense lines in the lower half are not fully legible and are transcribed only in part. Bottom of page has faint illegible print and a faded word at lower right.
